alexcrichton opened PR #14951 from alexcrichton:less-bail-bug to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit demotes a bail_bug! to a normal bail! when the event loop is required but it's not running. It's possible for this to happen on synchronous entrypoints like Func::call currently. Truly resolving this is deferred to #14950 but for now this at least ensures that bail_bug! isn't hit.
